doc: MCP servers Orbit knows about, as immutable product data shipped with the plugin. A row is never proof that anything is installed or enabled. A `recommended` row with a `definition` can be ADDED TO Orbit from Orbit Control: it then becomes a Orbit-managed resource kept in the machine store -- no host configuration is written. `install` says how its runtime gets here: remote-http (nothing to install), archive (pinned, SHA-256 per platform, into <storeBase>/runtimes/mcp/) or manual. Every row also RECOGNISES a server a host has configured (by id, url or command) so it can be shown with what it provides; such a server stays external and observe-only. `provides` names capabilities, never a skill. No row holds a secret: a definition names the environment variable a secret comes from.
